items.title: Statistics snapshot for June 2027
items.body: Quarterly figures on author positions were refreshed.

items.title: DEMO-2027-003 released: Stand and Model (2025), 2 claims
items.body: Proposition 1 is false as stated and Algorithm 1 can cycle. The authors disagree; their position is summarised below.

items.title: DEMO-2027-013 released: Prototype (2024), 2 claims
items.body: The proof of Remark 3 has a gap that a short argument repairs. A related gap in Lemma 4(b) is confirmed for the 2024 appendix but unresolved for the revised appendix, which could not be obtained.

items.title: DEMO-2027-002 version 1.2
items.body: Added an external human verification.

items.title: DEMO-2027-016 released: Surrogate, Token and Draft (2024), 3 claims
items.body: Theorems 2 and 4 and Lemma 3 are false as stated; each fails on a small instance.

items.title: DEMO-2027-011 version 1.1
items.body: Added the authors' written agreement.

items.title: DEMO-2027-001 released: Template and Proxy (2021), 4 claims
items.body: Two supporting lemmas are false as stated, and two applications hold only under an assumption the paper does not state. The main theorem (Theorem 1) was not examined.

items.title: DEMO-2027-015 released: Model (2026), 1 claim
items.body: The only-if direction of Proposition 4 is false as stated.

items.title: DEMO-2027-007 released: Pattern and Specimen (2019), 2 claims
items.body: No defect was found in Theorem 2. A claim in the online appendix could not be settled because the final version of the appendix was not available; it is reported as unresolved, not as a defect.

items.title: DEMO-2027-002 version 1.1
items.body: Added the published corrigendum and an audit of the corrected rules.

items.title: DEMO-2027-010 released: Fictive and Example (2022), 3 claims
items.body: No defect was found in Theorems 1 and 2. The proof of the Exit Lemma skips a case; the authors agreed and supplied a short argument that closes it.

items.title: DEMO-2027-017 released: Example and Instance (2025), 1 claim
items.body: Algorithm 1 does not always meet its stated approximation guarantee. The authors agreed.

items.title: DEMO-2027-004 released: Placeholder (2025), 2 claims
items.body: No defect was found in the main theorem. Lemma 5 relies on a cited result that does not cover its case, so its proof is incomplete; the lemma is not claimed to be false.

items.title: Statistics snapshot for March 2027
items.body: Programme-wide counts under metric definitions version 1.1.

items.title: DEMO-2027-005 version 1.1 (our correction)
items.body: Version 1.0 overstated the search for Theorem 3 (thirty-two players instead of sixteen). Findings unchanged.

items.title: DEMO-2027-011 released: Sample and Stand (2019), 2 claims
items.body: Theorem 2(a) is false as stated, and a step in Lemma B2 needs an assumption the paper does not state.

items.title: DEMO-2027-009 released: Token (2021), 2 claims
items.body: No defect was found in Propositions 3 and 6 within the stated scope. Parts of the proofs rely on a supplement that was checked only in its working-paper form.

items.title: DEMO-2027-018 released: Specimen (2025), 1 claim
items.body: No defect was found in Theorem 5 within the stated scope. This is not a proof that it is correct.

items.title: DEMO-2027-005 released: Instance (2023), 2 claims
items.body: No defect was found in Theorem 3 or Lemma 8 within the stated scope. This is not a proof that they are correct.

items.title: DEMO-2027-012 released: Variant (2003), 1 claim
items.body: Corollary 5.2 is false as originally printed. A corrigendum published in 2022, before this audit, already corrects it; the record documents a known error re-found by the method.

items.title: DEMO-2027-002 released: Sample and Variant (2025), 1 claim
items.body: The mechanism used to prove Theorem 2 does not work as printed. The authors agreed; Theorem 2 itself is not refuted.

items.title: DEMO-2027-008 released: Draft and Mock (2026), 2 claims
items.body: No defect was found in Theorem 1 or Corollary 2 within the stated scope. This is not a proof that they are correct.

items.title: DEMO-2027-006 released: Proxy and Surrogate (2018), 2 claims
items.body: No defect was found in either theorem within the stated scope. This is not a proof that they are correct.

items.title: DEMO-2027-014 released: Mock and Pattern (2018), 2 claims
items.body: No defect was found in Theorems 1 and 2 within the stated scope. This is not a proof that they are correct.
